risk_note: CT-06zzzzzl (FU-CI-PROPS-SHA2-HANG; D10-1932 / D10-1937 / D10-1938 / D10-1944 / D10-1945): test-change only — five frozen union property blocks ([AC-B1-04zzc#5], [AC-B1-04zzu#11], [AC-B1-04zzs#8], [AC-B1-04zzk#7], [AC-B1-04zzp#10]) each chain fc .afterEach(async (previous) => { await previous(); await setImmediate }) so every run yields one macrotask: @vitest/spy 5.0.5 markDirty() creates a WeakRef per mock that stays alive until the job ends, and the 100k-run loops never returned to the event loop, keeping every run’s vi.fn with its mock.calls (rows, gzip Buffers) to the end of the file (heap 2.3–6.3 GB, container peak up to 11.89 GiB; three CI shard-2/3 runners lost, couli-runs/FU-CI-PROPS-SHA2-HANG/facts.md). Assertions, arbitraries, propParams (runs / seed), timeouts, titles, kits and wire() / searchRows calls unchanged (git diff -w: +36 / −6); none of the blocks had hooks before. Measured on couli-ci (same isolation): with --max-old-space-size=2048 and PROP_RUNS=100000 (= CI) all five files pass (before: all five heap-out-of-memory), container peak 1.74–1.95 GiB, heap ≤ 280 MB; default runs 20/20 green. No new rule test (tester none).
